sig: [[["A", "Hey Daniel, got a sec? QA just found a critical bug in the login flow."], ["B", "Seriously? The release is tomorrow morning at nine."], ["A", "I know. Users with two-factor authentication can't sign in at all. That's roughly fifteen percent of our customers."], ["B", "That's a big chunk. Who's the best person to fix it?"], ["A", "Priya wrote that module, but she's on leave until Thursday."], ["B", "Hmm. What about Tom? He reviewed her code last month."], ["A", "He could, but he's already flat out with the database migration."], ["B", "OK, I'll take it myself, then. If it's a simple fix, I should have it done by tonight."], ["A", "And if it isn't?"], ["B", "Then we'll push the release to Friday. I'll give the product manager a heads-up just in case."], ["A", "Good idea. I'll ask QA to stay a bit later to retest."]], {"A": "F-AU", "B": "M-US"}]
